needed.evidence: informal paths and narrow sidewalks partly blocked by obstructions
needed.suggestion: Install a continuous, physically separated sidewalk with adequate width and remove obstructions to provide safe pedestrian access.

needed.evidence: obstructions along the sidewalk particularly close to the intersections
needed.suggestion: Remove parked vehicles and other obstructions from the sidewalk to ensure unobstructed pedestrian movement.

needed.evidence: uneven pavement visible along the sidewalk
needed.suggestion: Repair uneven sections on the sidewalk to eliminate trip hazards and improve pedestrian safety.

needed.evidence: people crossing in a carriageway with no designated crossing facility
needed.suggestion: Implement a marked pedestrian crossing at this location to guide and facilitate safe pedestrian crossings.

needed.evidence: no designated crossing facility increases the risk of pedestrians crossing against traffic
needed.suggestion: Introduce a signalised pedestrian crossing to ensure that drivers stop and pedestrians cross safely.

needed.evidence: no refuge island on a wide road without designated pedestrian crossing
needed.suggestion: Provide refuge islands at mid-block crossings to enable pedestrians to safely cross wide streets by giving a safe place midway.
